42038: The sources don't give its thickness or length (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md); its stiffness E b t³/12 L sets the balance's swing. Within −5 % to +11 % of the drawn spring's (0.387-0.408 mm thick at the drawn 13.55 mm width and 1064 mm length; about 0.74-0.86 N·m fully wound) the balance swings the manual's 1⅜-1½ turns (247.5-270°), and the escapement's rate changes -0.14 to +0.24 s a day, which the timing takes up. The drawn 0.394 mm is the coils' spacing on the videos (the parts list says 0.0165 in, 0.419 mm): measure the strip before fitting it. One of the parts list's 0.419 mm, the same length, swings the balance 283° (0.41 s a day fast before timing) and wants a larger barrel or a smaller core to wind the fusee's turns; one 0.374 mm thick (the other movement's spacing) only 233° (0.42 s a day slow). (The drive taken to scale with the spring's stiffness, the fusee evening it as drawn; tools/tolerances.js)
42087: The sources don't give its spring's section (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md). Its stiffness goes as its thickness cubed: up to 6.9 times the drawn spring's (0.150 mm thick, the drawn 0.079 over 3.82 mm to the point of flexure) the balance still swings 247.5° or more; stiffer, unlocking takes too much of the impulse. Its work sets no lower limit (with none, 256°): set its preload by the manual's test (Op. 78: a 0.770 g weight on the locking jewel just parts the spring from its stop button). A thinner spring still brings the detent back in time: from half to twice the drawn stiffness, and with no preload at all, it is back on its stop well before the next tooth reaches the stone, the preload doing most of the work (tools/tolerances.js, tools/dynamics.js)
42088: The sources don't give its thickness (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md). It bends only on the return swing (the horn backs it when it lifts the detent), but it is bent far, round the discharge jewel's end, and the work is lost when it flies back: up to 2.4 times the drawn strip's stiffness (0.081 mm thick, the drawn 0.06) the balance still swings 247.5° or more; thinner costs nothing. (tools/tolerances.js)
